C1.title: Policy in force
C1.text: Cover applies only while the policy is active on the date of admission.

C2.title: Initial waiting period
C2.text: No claim is payable for illness within 30 days of policy inception. Accidents are exempt.

C3.title: Pre-existing disease waiting
C3.text: Conditions that pre-date the policy, declared or not, are covered only after 24 months of continuous cover.

C4.title: Specific procedure waiting
C4.text: Listed procedures (cataract, hernia, gallbladder: 12 months; joint replacement: 24 months) carry a waiting period.

C5.title: Permanent exclusions
C5.text: Cosmetic surgery and dental treatment (other than accidental injury) are excluded.

C6.title: Room rent proportionate deduction
C6.text: Room rent is capped per day by plan. If exceeded, associated charges are reduced in the same proportion.

C7.title: Procedure sub-limit
C7.text: Payout for a procedure is capped at its listed sub-limit.

C8.title: Non-network co-payment
C8.text: Treatment at a non-network hospital carries a 10% co-payment.

C9.title: Mandatory documents
C9.text: Claim form, discharge summary, final bill and ID proof (plus operative notes for surgery) are required.

C10.title: Filing window
C10.text: Claims must be filed within 30 days of discharge; later claims need manager approval.

C11.title: Non-medical items
C11.text: Registration, admission kit, toiletries and similar non-medical charges are not payable.

C12.title: Remaining sum insured
C12.text: Payout cannot exceed the sum insured remaining after earlier claims in the policy year.

C13.title: Duplicate claims
C13.text: A claim for the same member, procedure and admission period already paid is not payable again.

C14.title: High-value review
C14.text: Claims above Rs 3,00,000 require medical officer sign-off.

C15.title: Fraud and misrepresentation
C15.text: Claims showing indicators of inflation, tampering or misrepresentation are referred for investigation.
